page: Factory Helper for creating typed Hono components. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {createFactory, createMiddleware} from 'hono/factory'. Functions: createFactory<Env>(options?), createMiddleware<Env>(handler), factory.createApp(), factory.createHandlers(). Type-safe factories for middleware and apps. Env generics: type Variables, type Bindings. Options: defaultAppOptions (HonoOptions like strict: false). Use cases: code organization, type reuse, middleware factory patterns. createFactory reduces type redundancy. initApp option for initialization. createHandlers spreads middleware and handlers into app.get(). Example patterns: middleware with arguments, handlers in separate files, database initialization. Questions: How to create factory? How to use Env types? How to reduce type duplication? sections.manifest: Import statements for Factory helper. import {Hono} from 'hono'. import {createFactory, createMiddleware} from 'hono/factory'. Questions: What to import?

createFactory() for typed factory instances. const factory = createFactory(). With Env types: createFactory<Env>(). Options: defaultAppOptions (HonoOptions, default app options like strict: false). Example: factory = createFactory<{Variables: {foo: string}}>(). createApp() method: factory.createApp() creates typed Hono instance. createMiddleware() method: factory.createMiddleware(handler). Reduces type duplication across components. Questions: How to create? How to use generics? What options? How to apply defaults?

createMiddleware() for custom middleware. const middleware = createMiddleware(async (c, next) => {...}). Shortcut: createMiddleware() equals factory.createMiddleware(). With types: createMiddleware<Env>(handler). Parameterized: wrap in function like (message: string) => createMiddleware(...). Usage: app.use(middleware) or app.use(middlewareFactory('arg')). Questions: How to create? With parameters? How to use? Type safety?

factory.createHandlers() for composable handlers. const handlers = factory.createHandlers(middleware1, middleware2, handler). Spreads into app: app.get('/api', ...handlers). Useful: define handlers separately from app. Combines: multiple middleware and final handler. Pattern: organize code across files. Questions: How to create handlers? How to spread? Why separate files? How to combine middleware?

factory.createApp() for typed app instances. const app = factory.createApp(). Returns: Hono instance with factory's Env type. Benefit: avoid repeating Env type definition. Single definition: type in createFactory. initApp option: initialize app after creation. Example: initApp: (app) => app.use(...) for middleware setup. Use case: database initialization, shared middleware. Pattern: separate factory file for reusable factories. Questions: How to create app? What Env? How to initialize? Why reduce duplication?
